newsitem.title: USA: TYPHOON WINNIE MOVES AWAY FROM MARIANA ISLANDS.
newsitem.headline: TYPHOON WINNIE MOVES AWAY FROM MARIANA ISLANDS.

text.p: Supertyphoon Winnie is now moving away from the Mariana Islands, independent forecaster Weather Services Corp said on Wednesday.
The storm hit the central and northern islands with damaging winds, flooding rains, and heavy coastal storm surge.
Major damage was likely and would be assessed over the next few days.
Winnie had 160 mph winds and would move west northwestward away from the islands over open water during the next 24 hours as a major threat to shipping, it said.
